references.text: Jonah was in the great fish for three days and three nights, which foreshadows Jesus' death and resurrection.
Jesus again mentions Jonah as a sign to this generation, emphasizing the need for faith without demanding further miracles.

Luke includes a similar account where Jesus speaks of Jonah as a sign, and how the people of Nineveh will rise up in judgment with this generation and condemn it because they repented at Jonah's preaching.
